description: Implementation of the BlobCache class for in-memory and application cache management in ANGLE project, supporting EGL_ANDROID_blob_cache.

classes.name: BlobCache
classes.description: Manages caching of binary blobs in memory and via application-provided functions, supporting EGL_ANDROID_blob_cache.

methods.name: BlobCache::BlobCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size.

methods.name: BlobCache::put
methods.description: Stores a blob in the cache, using application callback if set.

methods.name: BlobCache::putApplication
methods.description: Stores a blob in the application cache if callback is set.

methods.name: BlobCache::populate
methods.description: Adds a new cache entry with specified source.

methods.name: BlobCache::get
methods.description: Retrieves a blob from cache or application callback.

methods.name: BlobCache::getAt
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry at a specific index.

methods.name: BlobCache::remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: BlobCache::setBlobCacheFuncs
methods.description: Sets external callback functions for cache operations.

methods.name: BlobCache::areBlobCacheFuncsSet
methods.description: Checks if external callback functions are set.
